description: Birth chart of a celebrity or famous moment from Pluto Garden's sourced collection (e.g. Billie Eilish, Chappell Roan, Lana Del Rey, Bitcoin, the Moon landing). It only holds birth times the person gave themselves, with the source, so a missing name means no self-reported time is known. Returns the big three, placements, source and page link.

name.description: Name of the person or event, e.g. "Billie Eilish" or "Bitcoin".
